responsibility: This header declares the dynamic-string formatting interface used in the mc-boot runtime. It exports the fixed-arity Sprintf helpers and the escape-sequence translation routine that together provide the runtime's pseudo-printf service over DynamicStrings, distinct from direct file or terminal output modules.
same_name_distinction: Publishes the fixed-arity Sprintf and HandleEscape interfaces for the FormatStrings module, while the actual formatting parser and escape/percent processing logic are implemented in GFormatStrings.cc.
